message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are present anywhere in the data-acquisition path; data is loaded and used without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: External embeddings and models are loaded directly from local paths (e.g., 'data/external/embeddings/cc.en.300.bin') with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution checks, validation against an expected label set, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples in any of the data preparation code paths shown.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded from file paths (e.g., FastText, Word2Vec, BERT via transformers/sentence-transformers) without any hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1) are computed, there is no evidence of a cryptographically isolated or signed/hashed held-out test set, nor any mechanism to prevent metric manipulation or data leakage from training into evaluation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path applies no input shape, range, or schema validation before passing data to the model; only np.nan_to_num is used inside predict/predict_proba to silently coerce NaNs.

No detected output bounds checks: Although np.nan_to_num is applied to inputs before prediction, there is no check on output probabilities or predictions for NaN, out-of-range values, or calibration thresholds after the model returns results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a classical ML classifier (SVC/kNN/SGD/LGBM) for medical term classification, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
